name: Halving
description: A halving joint: two members each cut back to half their depth where they cross.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-clip-path: polygon(0 30%, 100% 30%, 100% 70%, 0 70%); clip-path: polygon(0 30%, 100% 30%, 100% 70%, 0 70%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-clip-path: polygon(30% 0, 70% 0, 70% 100%, 30% 100%); clip-path: polygon(30% 0, 70% 0, 70% 100%, 30% 100%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } @even { :after { z-index: 2; } } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
